why_this_is_nonduplicate.new_discriminator: Ask whether POSITIVE versus HARD_NEGATIVE supervision remains recoverable from cross-family lexical/surface cues even after the existing structural nuisance crossing.

method.unit: the 26 unique semantic scenario bodies: one POSITIVE and one HARD_NEGATIVE scenario for each of the 13 current generator blueprint families; repeated N/executor/presentation variants were intentionally collapsed because those nuisance factors are exactly balanced and the suffix is class-constant
method.model_visible_relevance: the scenario body is embedded verbatim into the generated model-visible prompt
method.classifier: TF-IDF word unigram+bigram features -> logistic regression
method.validation: LEAVE_ONE_PROCESS_FAMILY_OUT: 13 folds; train on 12 families (24 scenario bodies), test on the held family's positive+negative pair; each family is never present in its own training fold
method.statistical_caveat: The sample is tiny, hand-authored and deterministic, so the p-value is only a diagnostic warning signal, not a population estimate or scientific model-performance claim. The structural cue counts below are the stronger actionable evidence.

high_signal_surface_cues.risk: single-token polarity shortcut across many held-out process families

interpretation.observed: A shallow cross-family lexical classifier can recover supervision polarity far above chance from the current semantic scenario wording alone.
not_proven: This does not prove Qwen3.5-0.8B will use the same shortcut.
This does not prove the current 208 rows are useless as research donors.
This does not establish causal mechanism inside any model.
This does not mint dataset, training, J-Space, HCU or whole-product credit.
interpretation.counterhypothesis: The lexical asymmetry is harmless because a trained model will nevertheless learn the intended state/evidence transition semantics.
interpretation.cheapest_discriminator: Construct a lexically counterbalanced semantic-minimal-pair successor and require nuisance-only/polarity-only baselines to collapse toward chance before materializing a larger corpus.

semantic_minimal_pairs: Hold lexical/syntactic surface skeleton constant while changing the decisive typed state/evidence condition.
Where a wording cue must appear, cross it across both supervision polarities rather than letting terms such as proposal/claims/references become class markers.
Use counterfactual pairs that differ in exact evidence/ref/epoch/outcome/authority fields, not in overt good-vs-bad prose sentiment.
Preserve the same process family on both sides so the model must evaluate the transition condition rather than classify the topic.
all_process_training_coverage: Give every required trainable cognition capability a TRAIN family while keeping separate within-process causal/provenance families for VALIDATION and HOLDOUT.
Do not use CP10-CP13 being validation/holdout-only as the final training mixture; preserve that design only as an OOD benchmark slice.

Add ZECP20 JSPACE_OBSERVATION_CONTROL_RESEARCH boundary semantics, but block positive causal-control labels unless exact model-specific causal evidence exists. Safe negative/UNKNOWN/evidence-ceiling method rows may be trained without claiming causal success.
variable_n: Do not make N={10,20} the learned architecture identity.
Freeze at least one unseen smaller-N and one unseen larger-N family before training; exact values must be chosen in the immutable split manifest.
Add resize-during-task pairs with N_before/N_after while semantic process identity remains invariant.
Score process identity and correctness separately from scheduler/executor behavior.
hyperposition_and_abi: Regenerate inside the single retained semantic Hyperposition carrier after labeler/gate schema convergence.
Project targets toward exact COGNITIVE_PROCESS_ABI/ClayCode packet semantics rather than retaining English rule prose as the final inner representation.
Do not invent opaque atom strings before exact accepted ABI/tokenizer identities are byte-bound.
shortcut_acceptance: Run leave-one-process-family-out lexical/polarity baselines on exact rendered model-visible bytes.
Run semantic-ablation and nuisance-only decoders on exact rendered rows, including interactions rather than only marginal balance.
Use split-disjoint paraphrase/template families so memorized wording cannot masquerade as process transfer.
Reject any successor where a shallow surface-only challenger remains strongly predictive without access to the decisive semantic fields.
